PRE_FLIGHT_PROBE_RECORDED_BEFORE_THIS_LO.note_worth_recording: The freq-50 null median is 1.000061, which is the same order as the 1.000073 figure being cited. That resemblance is what the primary gate exists to adjudicate.
PRE_FLIGHT_PROBE_RECORDED_BEFORE_THIS_LO.what_it_establishes: That the null machinery runs and that a null distribution exists to compare against. It does NOT contain the primary quantity.
PRE_FLIGHT_PROBE_RECORDED_BEFORE_THIS_LO.what_was_probed: The NULL ONLY. Frequency-matched random word pairs, 300 pairs at each of several frequencies. The Salat and Zakat tracks were NOT touched and their VIF was NOT computed before this lock.

WHY_THIS_IS_THE_RIGHT_TEST.THE_RULE_BEING_APPLIED: A test that cannot fail is not evidence. Before a near-1.0 VIF may be cited, it has to be shown that a near-1.0 VIF was not guaranteed.
WHY_THIS_IS_THE_RIGHT_TEST.the_category_difference_that_matters: The yeast and GitHub VIFs were computed on CONTINUOUS NODE-LEVEL FEATURES -- clustering coefficient against betweenness, commit-message similarity against outsider-merge rate -- where every unit has a real value on both axes and collinearity is a live possibility. Per-ayah word counts are overwhelmingly zero. The two numbers are not the same quantity and must not be compared as though a shared name made them comparable.
WHY_THIS_IS_THE_RIGHT_TEST.the_claim: That VIF ~ 1.0 between a Salat-root track and a Zakat-root track shows the two hops are handled by the text as distinct, non-redundant operations -- the same orthogonality gate used on yeast (1.0026) and GitHub (1.0203).
WHY_THIS_IS_THE_RIGHT_TEST.the_worry: VIF = 1/(1-r^2). Across 6,236 ayahs almost every word is absent from almost every ayah, so two rare tracks are both nearly all zeros and r is nearly 0 whatever they mean. If so, VIF ~ 1.0 is arithmetic about sparsity, not a property of the text's design.

anti_immunisation: No threshold may be changed after any measurement. The primary is expected to fail on the probe evidence and will be reported as failed if it does.

gates.bar: 6,236 ayahs load; every declared track is non-empty; the null runs at >= 1000 frequency-matched random pairs

FEWER THAN 50 percent of frequency-matched RANDOM word pairs may clear the orthogonality bar of VIF < 1.05. If more than half of arbitrary unrelated pairs clear it, the gate separates nothing here and any near-1.0 VIF quoted from this text is uninformative. THIS GATE CAN PASS OR FAIL and its failure is a finding about our own instrument.
report the actual VIF and where it falls in the frequency-matched null distribution. No threshold: this gate asserts DISCLOSURE and is met by reporting.
report the VIF for every pair of the 8 declared tracks and the fraction clearing 1.05. Disclosure gate.

using the SAME matcher that scored 7 of 7 control proper nouns at zero in spec 708ac80e, the groups named by the roots S-L-M and A-M-N must be designated by a finite verb at least 5 times each. This arm uses a test already shown to discriminate.

EXCLUDED. It is not. Yeast and GitHub VIFs were computed on continuous per-node features where every unit has a real value on both axes. Per-ayah counts are overwhelmingly zero. Sharing a name does not make them comparable and no result here may be reported beside them as if it did.

EXCLUDED and OUT OF SCOPE. The units are word-forms in one text. Nothing here establishes what any word means, and nothing here is a claim about Jewish, Christian or Muslim people, communities or beliefs.

model: Does a VIF gate carry any information on Quranic word counts?
one_line: A VIF of 1.000073 has been quoted as proving that the text treats 'seeking' and 'sharing' as independent channel legs. This tests whether a near-1.0 VIF on this substrate distinguishes anything at all, or is forced by sparsity.
simulator_rule: One committed public dataset of 6,236 ayahs. Nothing simulated, no cohort invented.

the_tracks_declared_before_measurement.MUSLIM: root S-L-M: muslim / muslimun / muslimin / aslama forms
the_tracks_declared_before_measurement.SALAT: Arabic root S-L-W: forms of salat / yusalli / salawat
the_tracks_declared_before_measurement.ZAKAT: Arabic root Z-K-W: forms of zakat / yuzakki / azka / tazkiya

too_perfect_rule: A VIF quoted to six decimal places from sparse count data is a signal to look for an identity, not a triumph.

what_a_result_would_and_would_not_licens.either_way: Nothing licenses a claim that the text was DESIGNED with independent channel legs. Distributional independence of two word-tracks is not evidence of authorial architecture.
what_a_result_would_and_would_not_licens.if_W2_FAILS: Then a near-1.0 VIF on this text is uninformative, the quoted 1.000073 supports nothing, and the orthogonality gate must be marked NOT APPLICABLE on word-count substrates. That is a finding about our instrument, not about the text.
what_a_result_would_and_would_not_licens.if_W2_PASSES: Then the gate does discriminate here and the measured Salat/Zakat VIF can be read against the null.
